en: Color postcard view of a large Gothic church with two tall, ornate towers and a central façade facing an open cobblestone square. The church has pointed spires, intricate stone tracery, and a smaller red-roofed structure projecting from the middle of the front. Mature trees partly obscure the lower section. To the sides are historic multi‑story buildings with steep roofs and dormer windows. A few vintage cars and several pedestrians are visible, suggesting a mid‑20th‑century scene under a clear blue sky.
